theorem_title: Linear budget from an exponential return inequality
natural_language_statement:
Let $n,d\in\mathbb N$ satisfy $2\cdot32^d<27^d(n+1)$. Then

$$
10d+27<27n,\qquad d\le\left\lfloor\frac{27n-28}{10}\right\rfloor.
$$

The exponential inequality is an explicit premise; applications to any particular orbit must establish it separately.
